items.headline: Crawford, Zahn describe their love for Kentucky and Alabama
items.description: Hulu's "Chad Powers" co-stars Clayne Crawford and Steve Zahn join Marty & McGee and explain how their love for the Wildcats and Crimson Tide came to be.

items.headline: Bama's DeBoer speaks on how Russell gets comfortable in QB1 role
items.description: Kalen DeBoer expands on how more reps will help Keelon Russell get acclimated in the starting role and boost the Crimson Tide offensively.

items.headline: McElroy describes the positives of Kentucky's Minchey and Bama's Russell
items.description: ESPN's Greg McElroy joins SEC Nation and speaks on how Kenny Minchey and Keelon Russell did after their first starts and what they need to do to improve.

items.headline: Alabama offensive lineman Michael Carroll ruled out vs. Kentucky
items.description: Alabama offensive guard Michael Carroll has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Kentucky.

items.headline: Will Stein says it's time for Kentucky's vision to become reality
items.description: Stein joins The Paul Finebaum Show ahead of the Wildcats' matchup against the Crimson Tide to discuss how Kentucky can build on last week's win and lean on Big Blue Nation.

items.headline: SEC Nation duo insist Kentucky will keep things interesting vs. Alabama
items.description: Chase Daniel calls out Bama's rushing needs and praises Will Stein's "NFL-style plays" as Matt Barrie adds how the young coach has "brought some fire" to the UK program.
